title: Shift of Round-Configuration Heads
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb N$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $c$ be a configuration of a machine with $k$ work tapes and states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, and let a table word, a summary symbol, a state word, two integer head offsets, and an output list be given. Shifting the table and state head positions of the round configuration by natural numbers $a$ and $b$ yields exactly the round configuration whose table and state head positions have been increased by $a$ and $b$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $c$ of a $k$-work-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
